title: Simulation of One Machine Step
statement: Let $k,n\in\mathbb N$, let $x$ be a finite binary input, let $M$ be a $k$-tape machine with binary work tapes and states indexed by $\{0,\ldots,n\}$, and let $c$ be one of its configurations whose state is present. Let $d$ be a configuration of the round machine on the same input, with state at the live entry, and suppose $d$ represents $c$ and the transition table of $M$. If $\tau$ is the first positive time at which the round machine reaches either exit, then $0<\tau\le 50(L+1)$, where $L$ is the length of the encoded transition table. At time $\tau$ the round machine is at the live exit exactly when the state of the one-step successor of $c$ is present; its configuration represents that successor and its output is unchanged. At every intermediate positive time before $\tau$, it is at neither exit.
hypotheses_covered: Machine $M$ with $k$ binary work tapes and states indexed by $\{0,\ldots,n\}$
Configuration $d$ of the round machine on input $x$
